'''Mardu Avoa''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[President/Legends|president]] of the [[Drearian Defense Conglomerate/Legends|Drearian Defense Conglomerate]] and after Avoa's son was kidnapped by [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]], he was rescued by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Corvastan Benelex]]. Benelex's experience while rescuing Avoa's son inspired the [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] to subsequently found the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter chapter [[House Benelex]].
